title: Shadeform Launches Flex VMs to Turn Idle GPU Servers Into Rentable Cloud Capacity
summary:
The costs of underutilized hardware are being addressed by Shadeform through the release of two services, Flex VMs and Shadeform Spot, designed to monetize spare GPU power. These tools allow owners of bare-metal GPU servers to list their equipment as cloud capacity available to buyers within hours. To integrate the servers, providers only need to provide an IP address and an SSH key, eliminating the need to build a custom API.

The platform targets a market where high-demand GPUs often remain idle while their owners continue to absorb the overhead costs. By removing the technical barriers to listing spare capacity, Shadeform intends to provide more accessible compute resources for developers running AI experiments and post-training tasks.
